title: Figure 35: Evaluation of Object Sightings in Strategic Areas, Central Farwest Region
description: Regional map of central California and Nevada showing an outlined cross-shaped strategic area labeled "San Francisco 93 object sightings", linked to a pie chart of evaluations (Astro 11.6%, Aircraft 23.6%, Balloon 22.6%, Insuf. info. 16.1%, Other 19.4%, Unknown 6.6%). A second pie gives the "Balance of Central Farwest Region" (38 object sightings), with Aircraft at 36.9%. Caption: "FIGURE 35 COMPARISON OF EVALUATION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS IN THE STRATEGIC AREAS OF THE CENTRAL FARWEST REGION"; drawing B-7513, page 51.
